title: Complex Partial-Systolic QR Decomposition
source_docs: Fixed-Point Designer HDL Support/Matrices and Linear Algebra/Matrix Factorizations/Complex_Partial_Systolic_QR_Decomposition.md
text: QR decomposition for complex-valued matrices, 4 inputs, 4 outputs; {Number of rows in matrices A and B} sets the number of rows in input matrices A and B, {Number of columns in matrix A} sets the number of columns in input matrix, {Number of columns in matrix B} sets the number of columns in input matrix B and {Regularization parameter}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: validIn
ports.summary: Whether inputs are valid Boolean scalar

ports.name: restart
ports.summary: Whether to clear internal states Boolean scalar

ports.name: validOut
ports.summary: Whether output data is valid Boolean scalar

ports.name: ready
ports.summary: Whether block is ready Boolean scalar

params.name: Number of rows in matrices A and B
params.values: Number of rows in input matrices A and B 4 (default) | positive integer-valued scalar

params.name: Number of columns in matrix A
params.values: Number of columns in input matrix A 4 (default) | positive integer-valued scalar

params.name: Number of columns in matrix B
params.values: Number of columns in input matrix B 1 (default) | positive integer-valued scalar
